values.secret_data:
# OpenTelemetry Collector config for the otelcol-google Cloud Run sidecar.
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
        endpoint: localhost:4318

extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
  googleclientauth:

processors:
  resourcedetection:
    detectors: [gcp]
    timeout: 10s
  resource/gcp_project_id:
    attributes:
      - key: gcp.project_id
        value: ${env:GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}
        action: insert
  batch:
    send_batch_size: 200
    send_batch_max_size: 200
    timeout: 5s

exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: telemetry.googleapis.com:443
    balancer_name: pick_first
    auth:
      authenticator: googleclientauth

service:
  extensions: [googleclientauth, health_check]
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resourcedetection, resource/gcp_project_id, batch]
      exporters: [otlp]

identity_platform_tenants.description: Tenant display name to Identity Platform tenant id.

min_instance_counts.description: Cloud Run service name to its planned min_instance_count.

service_urls.description: Cloud Run service name to its deterministic run.app URL.

sql_connection_name.description: Cloud SQL instance connection name; unknown until creation.

object_admin_emails.description: Service-account emails granted object admin; must be known at plan time.

cpu_idle.description: CPU allocated only during requests; false keeps it allocated outside them.

custom_audiences.description: Exact extra OIDC audiences Cloud Run accepts besides the service URL.

env.description: Plain env vars of the app container; PORT is reserved by Cloud Run and must not be passed.

image.description: App container image reference with a pinned tag or digest, never latest.

ingress.description: Ingress setting; only the gateway uses INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALL.

invoker_members.description: IAM members granted roles/run.invoker, e.g. allUsers or serviceAccount:<email>.

name.description: Cloud Run service name, e.g. gateway or migration.

network.description: VPC network id or self link for Direct VPC egress.

otel_config_secret_id.description: Secret Manager secret id holding the collector config.

secret_env.description: App env var name to Secret Manager secret id.

subnetwork.description: Subnetwork id or self link for Direct VPC egress.

connection_name.description: Instance connection name (project:region:instance); unknown until creation.

iam_user_names.description: Map of service-account email to Cloud SQL IAM user name.

iam_service_account_emails.description: Service-account emails that get Cloud SQL IAM database users.

private_network.description: VPC network id for private IP (from modules/network output private_network).

args.description: Container arguments; null keeps the image default.

command.description: Container entrypoint override; null keeps the image default.

network.description: VPC network for Direct VPC egress.

secret_env.description: Env name to Secret Manager secret id.

tenants.description: Tenant display name to Identity Platform tenant id.

tenant_display_names.description: Identity Platform tenant display names, one per user-pool site; 4-20 chars, starting with a letter, letters, digits and hyphens only.

private_network.description: Network id for Cloud SQL private IP, available once private services access exists.

subnetwork_name.description: Subnet name for Direct VPC egress.

name.description: Base name for the network resources.

private_services_prefix_length.description: Prefix length of the private services access range for Cloud SQL.

region.description: Region of the subnet, router and NAT.

subnet_cidr.description: Subnet CIDR; Direct VPC egress needs at least a /26.

producer_email.description: Service account email of the producing service.

project_id.description: Project that owns the topic and subscriptions.

project_number.description: Project number, used for the Pub/Sub service agent.

pubsub_invoker_email.description: Service account email whose OIDC token signs push requests.

replay_subscriber_emails.description: Service account emails that may pull every DLQ replay subscription.

subscriptions.description: Push subscriptions keyed by subscription name.

creator_emails.description: Service-account emails that create, list and delete tasks on the queue and pause or resume it.

name.description: Queue name; equals the platform queue name.

retry.description: Retry policy; durations are strings such as "10s", and max_retry_duration may be omitted.

version_id.description: Version resource name, or null when no version exists.

accessor_members.description: IAM members granted secretAccessor, e.g. serviceAccount:<email>.

data.description: Payload of the single version; null creates the container without a version.

member.description: IAM member string for the account.

account_iam.description: Roles other principals hold on this account.

name.description: Account name; the account id is opt2-<name>.

project_id.description: Project that owns the service account and its bindings.

project_roles.description: Project-level roles granted to the account.

secret_access.description: Ids of existing Secret Manager secrets the account reads; each gets roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor for it.

cloud_run_services.description: Names of the deployed Cloud Run services; the topology generator reads this list.

database_name.description: Cloud SQL database name, also PG_DATABASE.

image_repository.description: Artifact Registry path prefix of the service images.

legacy_db_host.description: Legacy SQL Server host (MURA_DBHOST) of migration.

legacy_db_name.description: Legacy database name (MURA_DATABASE) of migration, strategies-content, identity and people.

legacy_db_port.description: Legacy SQL Server port (MURA_DBPORT) of migration.

legacy_origin.description: Legacy Masa origin (LEGACY_ORIGIN) of the gateway and migration.

legacy_settings.description: Non-secret Masa MURA_<KEY> settings of the legacy origin that the targets reproduce; each service gets the keys it reads.

operator_secret_ids.description: Ids of existing Secret Manager secrets the operator provides and Terraform only references: MURA_DBPASSWORD of migration; MURA_APPRELOADKEY of the legacy origin, null when legacy keeps Masa's default appreload; OPT2_IDENTITY_PLATFORM_API_KEY of identity, the project Web API key accounts:signInWithCustomToken takes.

plan_access_token.description: Placeholder provider access token; planning uses no credentials.

project_number.description: Google Cloud project number; builds Cloud Run URLs and the Pub/Sub service agent.

queues.description: Task queue name to target, creators, cadence and retry policy in seconds; generated by harness/src/repro/pubsub-topology.ts --target cloud.

service_calls.description: Caller service to the services it invokes; generated by harness/src/repro/pubsub-topology.ts --target cloud.

subnet_cidr.description: CIDR of the Direct VPC egress subnet; /26 or larger.

subscriptions.description: Push subscription <consumer>.<topic> to its delivery settings; generated by harness/src/repro/pubsub-topology.ts --target cloud.

time_zone.description: TZ of every service: the legacy server time zone.

topics.description: Topic name to producer and event kind; generated by harness/src/repro/pubsub-topology.ts --target cloud.
